one_line: Cloud data platform/warehouse with SQL analytics, data sharing, and AI/ML workloads.
auth_notes: Drivers use username/password or key-pair auth; OAuth2 for integrations; the Snowflake REST/SQL REST API uses JWT tokens derived from a private key or OAuth. Requires an account identifier and roles configured by an admin.
self_serve_notes: Free 30-day trial (no credit card), then paid. Creating an account is self-serve but provisioning users/roles/integrations is admin work.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Full SQL execution, SQL REST API, and admin REST endpoints for accounts, databases, roles, users; very broad data surface but gated by warehouse setup.

existing_mcp.note: Community MCP servers for Snowflake exist (e.g. snowflake-mcp); no official MCP confirmed.

evidence.note: Fetched URL returned a 404 shell; fields based on knowledge plus official docs URL.

agent_notes: Docs text was a 404 page. Account/trial creation plus admin-configured roles make first call slower than typical SaaS.
